capabilities: convert Markdown files to Atlassian Document Format (ADF)
render kroki-* code fences as diagrams via a trusted server
publish from a CLI, Docker image, GitHub Action or package library
support Obsidian Markdown extensions for richer Confluence content
extras: Detailed installation and usage instructions live in external documentation, not the README; a migration guide is required before upgrading from version 5.5.2 to 6; the README includes a license disclaimer limiting coverage to the integration itself.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish Markdown notes to Confluence or convert its Markdown extensions into Atlassian Document Format.

relations.evidence: See Kroki diagrams to render kroki-* fences through a trusted server in the CLI or Obsidian.

summary: Publishing tool that converts Markdown notes to Atlassian Document Format and uploads them to Confluence, also available as CLI, Docker, GitHub Action and library.
